name: SAB Events & Governance Now Media Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2014, SAB Events & Governance Now Media Ltd is in the business of advertising, sponsorship and on-ground or Virtual conferences[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SABEGNML, part of the SAB Group, operates in digital media and MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibitions). It runs the Governance Now portal (www.governancenow.com) and a YouTube channel with 500,000+ subscribers, focusing on governance-related reportage and analysis. With a team of senior journalists and expert writers, the company also organizes on-ground conferences, webinars, virtual events, and the Visionary Talks series to drive discussions on public affairs and governance.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -2.94% over past five years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 68.9% of their holding.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -9.55%
